edits.old: The contract review freezes the two paths and their field names before either is built against.
edits.new: The two paths are frozen as console operations under /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/rule-version-approvals, with the P7 approve called as a consumed operation, and are reconciled with the API Specification at contract review before the document is baselined. The version is read through the P7 version list, which returns change_checklist on each version; a single-version read, if the registry publishes one, replaces it at contract review without changing the gate. RuleVersionApproval carries versionId, packageCode, versionLabel, validFrom, checklistState, decisionRecordReference, decisionRecordState, state, approverReference, approvedAt and its effective dating (the version applies to decisions from validFrom, AC1). ChecklistItem carries one entry per checklist item code. DecisionRecordRef carries the entry id, the chain sequence and the outcome. The decisionRecordState value of a record written before a timed-out downstream call is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0831). The change_checklist is a jsonb object with one key per item code (request, impact, test result, approver, load, verify, rollback plan), each carrying a present flag and a free-text evidence reference; a version with a missing item is refused and the missing codes are named in the 409 body. The change request is one entry of the local decision-record chain of DP-03 binding the registry version, its test evidence and the approving role RW-RISK; the seven checklist codes and the seven version states (LOADED, VALIDATED, APPROVED, IN_FORCE, SUPERSEDED, ROLLED_BACK, REFUSED) are contract constants; the approval and the 00:01 promotion are left to the registry. The change-request operation and its path are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0868).

edits.old: The change-request operation and its path are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0868).
edits.new: The change-request operation and its path are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0868). The access-side pack check is a candidate version of this service's own access model, with PERMISSION, SCOPE and MASKING rows, served by POST and GET /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/pack-checks. Its three checks PC-ENT, PC-SCP and PC-MSK run over role, permission and masking_rule, with verdicts ACCEPTED and RETURNED. A decided pack version is refused a second decision with a 409. Its parameters access.pack.personalAreas and access.pack.rowLimit and the page bounds are read through DP-06. The verdict is written as an entry of the DP-03 chain under a record code and a pack row or defect item field set that are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2288). The load and the approval of a matrix version stay with the story that owns them.
